items.title: Maurice Durand Interview, 1958-08-22
items.q: Yeah, he sent him to my house to try to get me to play, join the band, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, he sent him to my house to try to get me to play, join the band, you know. Well, I didn't want to quit my band, you know. Go play on the boat.
When you played on the boat it was just there at New Orleans, you didn't go up the river
